d: US House Democrats are celebrating a sweeping victory in the 2026 US Midterm Elections, with Hakeem Jeffries declaring an “American tsunami” that has handed Democrats control of Congress. As Republicans face a major setback, Democrats are preparing to challenge President Donald Trump’s agenda, promising a renewed focus on affordability, healthcare and government accountability.
